definition: חָטַף verb catch, seize (Arabic ; compare Assyrian ta—‰îpu , oppression , Dl Pr 181 ; Late Hebrew חָטַף , Aramaic seize , חֲטַף do hurriedly ) — Qal Perfect וַחֲטַפְתֶּם consecutive Judg 21:21 literally, seize wives; Imperfect יַחֲטֹף עָנִי Ps 10:9 Infinitive לַחֲטוֺף עָנִי Ps 10:9 both figurative of oppressor catching the distressed; all followed by accusative

BDB2709 [H2414]

BDB2708 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB2710

חָטַף verb catch, seize (Arabic ; compare Assyrian ta—‰îpu, oppression, DlPr 181; Late Hebrew חָטַף, Aramaic seize, חֲטַף do hurriedly) —

Qal Perfect וַחֲטַפְתֶּם consecutive Judg 21:21 literally, seize wives; Imperfect יַחֲטֹף עָנִי Ps 10:9 Infinitive לַחֲטוֺף עָנִי Ps 10:9 both figurative of oppressor catching the distressed; all followed by accusative
